founder.name: Andrew Hayes
founder.headline: The 99-1 Rule: Your next fifty customers are already on LinkedIn. Get them with stories that grab their attention.

content.found: Andrew publishes long narrative stories on LinkedIn featuring named fictional personas to show how a reader who was not shopping for a product can stop scrolling for a story that fits their situation.
content.projected: Each week, story posts drafted under his name sit ready for his review before they go out.

inbound.found: His website offers a $295 pilot project that delivers a file of real consumer stories, and readers who engage with posts are directed to the comments or to DM him directly.
inbound.projected: A lead magnet under his name turns post readers into named leads by giving them a concrete piece of the 99-1 Rule to take away.

outbound.found: The corpus shows no record of follow-up to the people who reacted to or commented on his posts.
outbound.projected: A short personal note to every warm engager gets drafted for his review before it sends.

posts.source_quote: We ask them one question. What were you feeling when [X-Event] happened?

posts.hook: She called me on a Tuesday, about twenty minutes after I sent the file.
posts.source_quote: Our deliverable is the results file. The authentic human language told in the person's own words.

posts.hook: After a few stories run, I ask the client to look at who came back.
posts.source_quote: Every story you share leaves the readers, aka your future customers, thinking a little differently than they did before.

posts.hook: 95% of AI-generated marketing campaigns had no measurable return.
posts.source_quote: According to MIT, measuring $40 billion in spend, there was no measurable return. Zero.

posts.hook: A creative team I know once spent real effort trying to land a spot as vendors at a brand a lot of people want in with.
posts.source_quote: My credibility carries them. It covers the clumsy grabs at getting something only for themselves.

posts.hook: A production house once sent me a cost breakdown for an ad they never made.
posts.source_quote: Creative development included into their budget: 5% of total cost. While the mark up around 20% is fine

founder.name: Nerijus Danilevicius
founder.headline: Branding, design and webflow | Partner & Creative Director @ Simmer

audience.buyer_definition: a founder or marketing lead at a growing company who needs a brand refresh or new website

content.found: His own feed already carries first-person case-study posts about real projects like Plug, Hartnet, and Vegggal, published directly under his name.
content.projected: Once the system runs, a full week of posts sits ready under his name, waiting for his approval.

inbound.found: By his own description, incoming requests from companies and people already fill his week, leaving him little time to seek new clients.
inbound.projected: A lead magnet carrying his name would turn those same readers into named leads.

outbound.found: He personally thanks clients and collaborators by name inside his posts, engaging with the people who worked with him rather than through any separate outreach step.
outbound.projected: A short personal note goes out to every warm engager, drafted for his approval before it sends.

posts.hook: Skrifttypen på Hartnet sin nye nettside kommer fra et fransk foundry, valgt for å matche håndverket i kjøkkenene de lager.
posts.source_quote: Fonten vi valgte heter Writer, fra det franske foundry'et pangram Pangram. Inspirert av fransk renessanse.

posts.hook: Hartnet sin nye side og logo har vært live en stund nå, og vi bruker fortsatt tid på å justere den.
posts.source_quote: Nå gjelder det å optimalisere videre som er like viktig for små og store budsjett nettsider.

posts.hook: Når vi leverer en side i Webflow, får kunden full kontroll over den med en gang.
posts.source_quote: Med Webflow har vi gitt kundene våre kontroll. De oppdaterer selv, endrer innhold, legger til sider uten venting og ekstra kostnader.

posts.hook: Vi leverte Maler Hansen sin nye nettside en tirsdag, og torsdag var trafikken akkurat like lav som uken før.
posts.source_quote: Vente på at Google og kundene oppdager den nye siden og følge med på resultatene.
